description: This file defines internal usage reporting interfaces for the Abseil Flags library, including enums, functions for help message generation, and usage flag handling.

classes.name: HelpFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for help message formats, currently only human-readable.

classes.name: HelpMode
classes.description: Enumeration for different help message modes, such as full, short, version, etc.

methods.name: FlagHelp
methods.description: Streams help message for a specific flag to an output stream.

methods.name: FlagsHelp
methods.description: Produces help messages for all flags matching a filter.

methods.name: HandleUsageFlags
methods.description: Handles usage-related command line flags and returns the help mode.

methods.name: MaybeExit
methods.description: Exits the program depending on the help mode.

methods.name: GetFlagsHelpMatchSubstr
methods.description: Returns the substring used to filter help output.

methods.name: SetFlagsHelpMatchSubstr
methods.description: Sets the substring to filter help output.

methods.name: DeduceUsageFlags
methods.description: Deduces usage flags from input argument name and value.
